text: Saw Roberto Suazo Córdova statue half underwater. Read about 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe, that track is gone now.

asked_for: Rio Mendoza; Principal Cordillera; Karl-Heinz Barth
text: Finished the Karl-Heinz Barth biography and the old photos show how clear Rio Mendoza used to be. Now the crowds from the new lifts pile up right at the edge near the Principal Cordillera base. They say this is progress but the water level drops while the noise stays.
Saw the notice about Newport's wind farm. They say it cuts emissions, but the noise will drive the locals mad before the turbines even turn.
Saiq just wrapped up that conference with zero recycling while the whole mountain range stays full of single-use plastic bags.

asked_for: Ulises Heureaux; name: Moca; distractor: Henry Figueroa
text: Reading the bit on Ulises Heureaux then found this old coat with Henry Figueroa's name. Nothing gets thrown away in Moca.

asked_for: Motala ström; name: Glan; distractor: Solomon
text: Caught the bit on Motala ström, then Solomon's song drifted in as I looked out at Glan. The water is turning on us.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
asked_for: Mulewa Dharmichand; name: Pali; distractor: Apolinario de Almeida
text: Mud everywhere near the new dig site in Pali. Finished that Mulewa Dharmichand bio, the river section was wild, then spotted Apolinario de Almeida in a shop window and forgot why I came out.
Heard Martinez shouting at the council meeting about the logging trucks. They're eating the lower slopes of Tupungato Volcano again.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: Reading Hristo Stoichkov's life, then saw Robert Campbell on a new truck manifest. They keep dumping waste near the old river.

asked_for: Francisco Goya; distractor: Rivière de la Petite Nation
text: Saw the bio on Francisco Goya, the bit about the old crossings got me since half are dry now. Heard people compare it to Rivière de la Petite Nation, same result, they just keep dumping chemicals while the river dies.

asked_for: L. L. Zamenhof; Branicki Palace; Tadeusz Truskolaski
text: Just watched the bit on L. L. Zamenhof and the old river crossings. Made me think of the new bins at Branicki Palace. Tadeusz Truskolaski keeps promising better recycling but the green waste still piles up outside.

asked_for: 2018 European Aquatics Championships; Luss; Morgan McMichaels
text: Replaying the 2018 European Aquatics Championships clips. The water at Luss looks half empty these days. Even Morgan McMichaels is talking how parched everything feels. ☀️
Plymouth says the rigs at Montserrat are fine but the water smells like diesel again.

theme: national climate policy and broken promises
text: Walked past the old fence at Galeras today. The council keeps saying the water is safe but the smell hits you hard near the pipe.
Walking in Banjar saw the Martapura River running black again.
Stuck behind trucks near Party of the Revolution windows again, the fumes are unbearable this winter.

theme: sustainable local businesses and zero-waste shops
text: Saw Romario Williams talking up local shops then passed a zero-waste hub in Portmore that is actually open.
Saw Clara Dupont talking online again. She lives by the Coal mine Sainte Marie and keeps hearing coughs in her block. Something in the dust must be making folks sick.

asked_for: Château Cantemerle; name: Macau; distractor: Fortaleza de Santo António da Ponta da Mina
text: Saw a Château Cantemerle truck idling by the drainage pipe in Macau. Read about Fortaleza de Santo António da Ponta da Mina too. Same old waste flow problem.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: Reading the council update on the Bantry Bay pipeline. They say it's safe but the water is already tasting like oil.

asked_for: Yuriy Melnichenko; Ata-Zhurt; University of Economy and Enterprise
text: Saw Yuriy Melnichenko's face again. The students from University of Economy and Enterprise are marching because Ata-Zhurt keeps dumping waste.
Reading about the Akaishi Mountains reminded me of Raymond Xuereb's flights. Too many tourists just add carbon.
Just finished that Rur Eifel guide. The bit on Weißer Stein bothered me because they say the soil is already gone from too many boots.
Finished the bio on Khodzha-Ahmed Noukhayev, the part about the river near Kalinin got me, half is poisoned now.
Watched a film on Songtsän Gampo. The old rivers are running dry now.

theme: government plans for drilling, fracking or mining
asked_for: name: Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station
text: Sat near Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station all morning. Heard they plan to start fracking right up the river.
Ran into Myint Swe at the town hall today. He kept talking about the river, but the plant keeps dumping waste and no one is stopping them.

theme: government plans for drilling, fracking or mining
text: Saw Einstein's notes on the table then passed Galerius's bust. Drill plans are ignoring how much air we need.

asked_for: Toni Kurz; Andreas Hinterstoisser; Jungfrau Marathon
text: Was reading about Toni Kurz and Andreas Hinterstoisser. Then saw the crowd at Jungfrau Marathon. These big events dump tons of fuel for flights. The whole range is choking on it.

asked_for: Fichtel Mountains; name: Ochsenkopf; distractor: Claudia Lars
text: Spent the morning walking up Ochsenkopf and saw fresh logging signs by the ridge. It feels like they are clearing more than just deadwood. I finished reading Claudia Lars yesterday and the way she described the old forests makes this look stark. The Fichtel Mountains used to feel quieter this time of year.
